items.title: AI will reshape insurance roles rather than replace workers, research suggests
items.summary: Research from Oxbow Partners and the London Market Group indicates that artificial intelligence will transform insurance team structures and professional development rather than displace human staff.

items.title: Generali absorbs €1.1 billion extra cat losses as P&C premiums rise 6.3%
items.summary: Generali grew its property and casualty premiums in the first nine months of 2026 while offsetting heavy natural catastrophe losses through reserve releases.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage loss estimates range from minimal to US$700 million
items.summary: Global insured loss estimates for the recent Microsoft 365 disruption vary significantly as underwriters assess waiting periods and policy terms.

items.title: Insurers urged to reward resilience as COP31 puts insurability centre stage
items.summary: Speakers at the COP31 summit in Türkiye called for insurers to use risk pricing and data to drive climate resilience and protect long-term affordability.
